sentences.text: 最简单的定义把衰退界定为GDP连续两个季度负增长。
sentences.evidence: The simplest defines recessions as two consecutive quarters of negative GDP growth.

sentences.text: 扩张与衰退的周期长度通常约为2至10年。
sentences.evidence: Typically, their periodicity ranges from about 2 to 10 years.

sentences.text: 西斯蒙第1819年的《政治经济学新原理》首次系统阐述了与经济均衡理论相对立的经济危机理论。
sentences.evidence: The first systematic exposition of economic crises, in opposition to the existing theory of economic equilibrium, was the 1819 Nouveaux Principes d'économie politique by Jean Charles Léonard de Sismondi.
